description: This file defines the interface 'FileSystemInterface' for file operations in Drupal, including methods for moving, copying, deleting, and managing files and directories, as well as constants for file handling flags and insecure extensions.

classes.name: FileSystemInterface
classes.description: An interface defining methods for file and directory operations, including moving, copying, deleting, permission setting, and directory scanning, with constants for handling existing files and insecure extensions.

methods.name: moveUploadedFile
methods.description: Moves an uploaded file to a new location, supporting streams and normal paths.

methods.name: chmod
methods.description: Sets permissions on a file or directory, supporting stream wrappers.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes a file or URI, handling Windows read-only issues.

methods.name: realpath
methods.description: Resolves the absolute filepath of a local URI or path.

methods.name: dirname
methods.description: Gets the directory name from a path or URI.

methods.name: basename
methods.description: Gets the filename from a path, deprecated in favor of PHP's native basename.

methods.name: mkdir
methods.description: Creates a directory, optionally recursively, with explicit mode setting.

methods.name: rmdir
methods.description: Removes a directory, handling Windows read-only issues.

methods.name: tempnam
methods.description: Creates a unique temporary filename, supporting stream wrappers.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies a file to a new location, with options for handling existing files.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a file without database or hook invocation.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves a file or URI to a new location, supporting stream wrappers.

methods.name: saveData
methods.description: Saves data to a file without invoking file hooks or database updates.

methods.name: prepareDirectory
methods.description: Ensures a directory exists and is writable, creating or modifying permissions as needed.

methods.name: createFilename
methods.description: Creates a unique filename in a directory.

methods.name: getDestinationFilename
methods.description: Determines the destination path for a file, handling existing files.

methods.name: getTempDirectory
methods.description: Returns the configured temporary directory path.

methods.name: scanDirectory
methods.description: Finds files matching a pattern in a directory, supporting recursion and filtering.
